UpdateStageDescription: Stores the elastic superuser password in the Elasticsearch keystore
UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p='{{ElasticPassword}}'; if (-not $p) { exit 0 }; Set-Location -LiteralPath '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; $env:ES_PATH_CONF='{{$FullBaseDir}}config'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText('{{$FullBaseDir}}tmp\bootstrap.txt', $p); cmd.exe /c 'es\bin\elasticsearch-keystore.bat add -x -f bootstrap.password < tmp\bootstrap.txt'; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item -LiteralPath '{{$FullBaseDir}}tmp\bootstrap.txt'; if ($rc -ne 0) { Write-Output 'Failed to store the elastic password in the keystore'; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'Stored the elastic password in the keystore'"

UpdateStageDescription: Stores the elastic superuser password in the Elasticsearch keystore
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "P='{{ElasticPassword}}'; [[ -z $P ]] && exit 0; printf '%s\n' \"$P\" | ES_PATH_CONF='{{$FullBaseDir}}config' '{{$FullBaseDir}}es/bin/elasticsearch-keystore' add -x -f bootstrap.password || { echo 'Failed to store the elastic password in the keystore'; exit 1; }; echo 'Stored the elastic password in the keystore'"
